claims.claim: The sole current registry profile is brain-high-value-v2 version 2. It retains the four applicable flows and BP-4A procedure and bounds, adds lens_check_bytes=2048, and contains one procedural check for each of the eight ordered lenses.
The parser requires closed {id, check} lens records in the exact eight-lens order and rejects malformed, non-JSON, invalid Unicode, and over-bound profile material.

profile_ref hashes the normalized complete profile body, including lens checks. Stage 1 binds that ref into construct_fingerprint, and Stage 2 compares the supplied Stage 1 construct against the current packet and profile.

The BP-4A audit and closure logic retains its two-stage structure; its ordered coverage check now reads lens IDs from the profile records. No provider invocation or additional production file was introduced.
